meta.description: Registry for symbolic stability conditions for Pi_A under admissibility-window perturbation in Phase 3.

symbolic_stability_conditions.statement: The admissibility window A is non-empty before and after perturbation.
The perturbed window A' remains within declared admissibility-equivalence tolerance of A.
Pi_A maps candidates into A and Pi_A' maps candidates into A'.
For x with Pi_A(x) in A and Pi_A'(x) in A', the projected outputs remain equivalent under admissibility_equivalence.
No boundary crossing converts a non-null admissible candidate into null/inadmissible status unless explicitly flagged as bifurcation_possible.
